abort.already_configured: This Flame King scale is already configured.
abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device does not match a supported Flame King scale.

error.invalid_area: The selected room no longer exists. Choose another room.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name for this scale.
error.no_devices_found: No supported Flame King scale was found. Turn on the scale, close any app connected to it, and scan again.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up the discovered Flame King propane scale {name}. Choose the cylinder size; you can optionally override its typical empty weight on the next screen.
bluetooth_confirm.title: Configure discovered propane scale

tare_override.description: A {size} cylinder will use the typical {tare} empty weight. Leave this blank to accept it, or enter the TW stamped on your cylinder if it differs.
tare_override.title: Optional empty-weight override

user.description: Home Assistant looks through the Bluetooth devices it has recently seen for a Gas Monitor and checks its Flame King fingerprint. No address entry is required. Turn on the scale, close any app connected to it, and submit to look again.
user.title: Find Flame King propane scale

error.invalid_loaded_points: The two loaded measurements do not form a valid increasing calibration. Use two different known weights and let each reading settle.
error.load_not_detected: The loaded reading was not greater than the unloaded reading. Check placement and try again.
error.no_live_reading: No live reading is available. Turn on the scale, make sure no other app is connected, and try again.
error.same_calibration_points: Raw zero and raw reference must be different.

menu_option_descriptions.advanced: View or enter the raw calibration values directly.
menu_option_descriptions.calibrate: Check the unloaded state, then fit the scale from two known loaded weights.
menu_option_descriptions.reset_calibration: Erase the scale calibration and restore Flame King's factory conversion.
menu_option_descriptions.power: Control scheduled readings and change-monitoring behavior.
menu_option_descriptions.tank: Choose the tank size and optionally override its typical empty weight.

tank.description: Choose the cylinder's rated propane capacity (US sizes are in pounds; a custom size is entered in lb). Auto follows Home Assistant's unit system. Its typical empty weight will be selected automatically on the next screen.
tank.title: Tank settings

tank_tare_override.description: The {size} preset uses a {tare} empty weight. Leave this blank to use the preset, or enter the TW stamped on your cylinder if it differs.
tank_tare_override.title: Optional empty-weight override

power.description: The scale is read briefly at the regular interval. When the weight changes significantly, or gas flow is detected, it is read every active interval (at least 15 seconds) until it has been quiet for about the fast polling window. Failed readings do not count as quiet, and a few failures in a row return to the regular interval. The long-use setting controls the Extended gas use binary sensor.
power.title: Polling and battery

calibrate.description: Turn on the scale, remove every load, and wait for it to settle. Submit to record the firmware's no-load state. This check is used to recognize an empty platform; it is not treated as a loaded calibration point. Current raw reading: {raw}.
calibrate.title: Step 1: Check unloaded scale

reset_calibration.description: Submit to erase the current load-cell calibration and restore the Flame King factory values (raw zero 64; raw reference 1600 at 6 kg). Tank tare, propane capacity, name, room, and polling settings are not changed. You can run Guided scale calibration afterward to measure this individual scale again.
reset_calibration.title: Reset factory calibration?

menu_option_descriptions.calibrate_empty_tank: Use the configured stamped tare weight as the known load.
menu_option_descriptions.calibrate_known_weight: Enter the weight of another accurately known load.

calibration_reference.title: Step 2: Choose the first loaded weight

calibrate_empty_tank.description: Place the confirmed-empty cylinder on the scale, disconnected from hoses or accessories, and wait for the reading to settle. Its configured tare weight of {tare} will be used automatically. Current raw reading: {raw}.
calibrate_empty_tank.title: Capture first load: empty cylinder

calibrate_known_weight.description: Place an accurately known weight on the scale and wait for the reading to settle. Enter only its real weight; the raw reading is captured automatically. Current raw reading: {raw}.
calibrate_known_weight.title: Capture first known load

calibrate_second_load.description: First point captured: {first_weight} at raw {first_raw}. Replace it with a different known load, or add a known weight and enter the new total. A household reference near the normal working range (about 9–18 kg / 20–40 lb) is adequate; weigh it separately and round honestly to about 0.1 lb or 0.05 kg. Current raw reading: {raw}.
calibrate_second_load.title: Step 3: Capture second loaded weight

advanced.description: Diagnostic fallback for manually entering the fitted raw-zero intercept and one loaded reference point. Guided calibration is recommended.
advanced.title: Advanced manual calibration

raw_points_equal.message: Raw zero and raw reference must be different.
